reason: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness utility focused on token and spending management: it processes model call usage into cost records, stores usage/billing data locally, and presents balance, budget, and summaries in the UI with optional official price/balance sync.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按调用记录成本并汇总显示余额、预算及会话/今日/本月/累计费用，并支持官方价格与余额同步。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness records per-call cost usage, tracks balances and budgets, and shows session and period summaries, with optional synchronization of official pricing and balance data.

capabilities: Tracks token usage from LLM calls and computes cost estimates.
Persists billing ledger and retention settings locally.
Displays balance, budget, and session/timeline summaries in UI panels.
Fetches official pricing and account balance data from external endpoints.

reasons.code: Plugin is described as a billing plugin that hooks model call usage, computes per-call cost, and stores a persistent ledger.
The manifest declares a web client/patch plugin package and runtime wiring for Typert-based state/config RPC, indicating active plugin behavior in host and browser surfaces.
Source layout includes storage, pricing, host, and client modules, and explicitly documents official balance/price synchronization behavior.
